newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet steady, backwardation keeps buyers relaxed.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet steady, backwardation keeps buyers relaxed.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were steady on Tuesday as scarce prompt demand was countered by a lack of handy-sized cargoes.
"No one's prepared to pay the backwardation," said one trader. "There isn't any huge demand."
Even though smaller cargoes were reported to be in short supply, a 10,000 tonne stem offered by a U.K. major attracted no bids. Largers cargoes talked around Nov IPE +$35/$36, cif NWE.
Benchmark IPE gas oil futures were trading at a $10 backwardation on the Oct/Nov spread at 1516 GMT.
